title: Correct final distance
description: Essential Criteria: The response must give the exact distance from M to A as MA = (3 - √3)l/3 or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Snell's Law application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Snell's law at the entry point M to find the refraction angle (30° from the normal, given n=√2 and incidence=45°).

title: Geometry of internal path
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly trace the beam's path using geometry, establishing angles like ∠BMO = 60° and the incidence angle on BC as 15°.

title: Reflection law on BC
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the law of reflection at the coated base BC, showing the reflected ray makes an equal angle (15°) and heads toward A.

title: Triangle similarity or trig
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use triangle similarity (e.g., ΔBMO ~ ΔBAO) or trigonometry to relate segment BM to the known side length l.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The final answer should be expressed with the correct unit (l) and maintain dimensional consistency throughout.

title: Sign or angle confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize confusing the angle of incidence/refraction, or misidentifying geometric angles (e.g., assuming 45° refraction).

title: Incorrect path to A
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize solutions that fail to ensure the reflected beam precisely targets vertex A, violating the given condition.
